intro M R
intro comm_monoid
intro comm_ring
intro finite_M
intro has_enough_roots

have card_Mx : Nat.card Mˣ = Nat.card M := by exact Finite.card_eq_card_of_finite comm_monoid finite_M

let n := Nat.card Mˣ

have roots_card : Nat.card (rootsOfUnity n R) = n :=
  HasEnoughRootsOfUnity.natCard_rootsOfUnity R n has_enough_roots

let char_group : AddCommGroup (MulChar M R) := by apply_instance
let char_module : Module R (MulChar M R) := by apply_instance
let char_submodule : Submodule R (MulChar M R) := by apply_instance

have card_char : Nat.card (MulChar M R) = Nat.card (MulChar M R ⧸ char_submodule) * Nat.card char_submodule :=
  Submodule.card_eq_card_quotient_mul_card R (MulChar M R) char_submodule

have card_submodule : Nat.card char_submodule = 1 :=
  by
    let zero_char : 0 ∈ MulChar M R := by apply_instance
    let zero_submodule : 0 ∈ char_submodule := by exact zero_char
    let zero_submodule : 0 ∈ char_submodule := by exact zero_char
    haveI : IsSubmoduleZero char_submodule := by apply_instance
    haveI : IsSimpleModule R char_submodule := by {
      intro a
      intro h
      cases h with x y
      exact eq_zero_of_is_simple_module R char_submodule a h
    }
    exact Nat.card_eq_one_iff_is_simple_module R char_submodule

exact calc
  Nat.card (MulChar M R) = Nat.card (MulChar M R ⧸ char_submodule) * Nat.card char_submodule := card_char
  ... = Nat.card (MulChar M R ⧸ char_submodule) * 1 := card_submodule
  ... = Nat.card (MulChar M R ⧸ char_submodule) := by rw mul_one
  ... = Nat.card Mˣ := by rw card_Mx
